title: Four O'Clock Prices
logline: Before dawn at a great wholesale vegetable market, lorries arrive all at once, prices change by the minute, and a trader juggles buyers, a phone and a scale until the rush breaks into sudden quiet.
human_question: What happens to our attention when everything arrives at once?

premise.story: One trader's night at a wholesale market, from the first lorries to the moment the stall is empty. The stakes are real: prices, spoilage, debts and the next harvest.
premise.place: A vast dry-zone wholesale market lit by bulbs and headlights: sacks of carrots and beans, handcarts, shouting, diesel, then daylight on bruised leaves.
premise.experience: The viewer is carried by the rush and then dropped into the stillness after it, feeling how scattered attention is made by conditions.

concept_links.why: Margaya ties restlessness to sudden situations, doing many things at once and working in a hurry [C008-M:L20]. The market shows those conditions. It does not show anyone's inner state or fault.
The source's image for restlessness is water ruffled by the wind; the film can hold the rush and the calm after it without naming anything.

what_camera_could_observe: Lorries queuing in the dark; sacks thrown down in rhythm
A trader handling several buyers, a phone and a weighing scale at once
A count lost and started again; half-finished sentences
The moment the rush breaks: a cup of tea, a sweep of the floor, sleep on a sack
what_must_be_real: The trader's work, prices and pressures must be real. Nothing is slowed down or sped up for the camera beyond what the edit does.

possible_arc.opening: Headlights, noise, and too many things happening at once.
possible_arc.turn: The rush peaks and something is nearly missed or lost.
possible_arc.ending_open: The quiet after. Whatever the trader actually does and says once it is over leads the ending.

requirements: A working wholesale market with a trader willing to be followed for a whole night
Safe camera positions among moving lorries and carts

suggestions.name: Dambulla Dedicated Economic Centre
suggestions.why: The best-known wholesale vegetable market in Sri Lanka, where produce from many regions changes hands.
suggestions.access_notes: Very busy; filming needs management permission
suggestions.verify: Trading hours, filming permissions and a willing trader are unverified.

risks: Making busy working people look like an illustration of a mental flaw
Chaos footage with no person at the centre
Safety in a crowded working space
drop_if: No trader will let the camera stay with them through the whole rush

connections.note: The rush that scatters attention here is answered at the end of the group by work that can only be done slowly.
A public, commercial rush set against a private household rush of preparation.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
